comment: Rulings shown on hover and in the rules reference. Spec v2.0 RULINGs, Q&A overrides and the Round 2 house rules (build prompt §3). byCard / byType link them to cards.

A5-a.title: Hand
A5-a.text: No mulligan and no maximum hand size.

A7-a.title: White-only costs
A7-a.text: If a card has a white cost but no coloured cost, the destroyed Creation Units may be of any type.

A7-b.title: Paying
A7-b.text: When there is a choice of which Creation Units to deplete or destroy, the player chooses.

A7-c.title: Creation Units
A7-c.text: Creation Units are never played from hand — they enter the Lab directly during the Draw phase.

A7-d.title: Off-turn Power cards
A7-d.text: You may play Power cards during your opponent's Battle step 3 too, paying with your un-depleted Creation Units.

A7-e.title: Equipment stays
A7-e.text: Equipment stays attached when its unit is depleted or replenished. If the unit leaves play, its Equipment goes to the discard pile.

A8-a.title: Step order
A8-a.text: Cyborg Abilities happen before Battle Determination.

A8-b.title: Blocking
A8-b.text: At most one defender (unit or stack) may block each attacker.

A8-c.title: Disoriented
A8-c.text: Lasts until the end of the Battle phase. A Disoriented unit cannot destroy, but still adds its full Physical total and can be destroyed.

A8-d.title: Re-roll
A8-d.text: A re-roll is optional; the player decides after seeing both totals. The new result replaces the old one.

A9-a.title: Containment escape
A9-a.text: Once per turn, in the contained unit owner's Cleanup phase. A released unit stays in its Lab, depleted.

A10-a.title: Simultaneous loss
A10-a.text: If all remaining players would lose at the same moment, the game is a draw.

B1-a.title: Power card timing
B1-a.text: Each Power has a timing: Reactive (any priority window, any turn, including responses) or Creation (your own Creation phase, nothing waiting to resolve).

B1-b.title: Lodner Predator
B1-b.text: The roll happens in the Cyborg Abilities step, only when attacking; one roll per attack. On Obliterate (side 6) the top card of the defender's Resource Deck is discarded.

B1-c.title: Blade Master
B1-c.text: Works when attacking or defending, including as part of a Stack.

QA-1.title: No summoning sickness
QA-1.text: Battle Units enter play ready and may attack the turn they are created.

QA-2.title: Equipment works immediately
QA-2.text: Equipment boosts stats the turn it is played, on attack and on defence. Equipment is never depleted.

QA-3.title: Replacing Equipment
QA-3.text: To give a unit new Equipment, its old Equipment must first be moved to another legal unit or discarded. Equipment without a unit is discarded automatically.

QA-4.title: Reactive Powers
QA-4.text: A Reactive Power may be played in any priority window, on any turn. Players may respond; responses resolve last-played-first.

QA-5.title: Power-card window
QA-5.text: The Battle phase Power-card window always happens, even when no attackers are declared.

QA-6.title: Jingwa's reveal
QA-6.text: The opponent chooses which Power card to reveal. It is only shown, not discarded.

HR-A.title: Choosing targets (3–4 players)
HR-A.text: Each attacking unit picks which opponent it attacks; an army may be split.

HR-B.title: Blocking (3–4 players)
HR-B.text: Only the player being attacked may block.

HR-C.title: Power-card window order
HR-C.text: Every player may act, in turn order starting with the attacker, until everyone passes in succession.

HR-D.title: Elimination
HR-D.text: An eliminated player's cards all leave the game; restrictions their cards placed end. Last player standing wins.

HR-E.title: "Opponent" in card text
HR-E.text: Means the player on the other side of that battle. High-Energy Pulse affects everyone.

HR-G.title: Starting HP and first turn
HR-G.text: Same starting HP as 2-player; only the first player skips their first Battle-Deck draw.

HR-J.title: Timers
HR-J.text: Optional turn timer, off by default.

HR-K.title: Responding to Powers
HR-K.text: Players may respond to a Power with a Reactive Power; the stack resolves last-played-first.

HR-L.title: Power cards are instant
HR-L.text: Superseded in v0.4.1: each Power card has its own timing (Reactive or Creation).

HR-M.title: Response windows
HR-M.text: Every player gets a short response window (3 s by default) so a pause reveals nothing about who holds a Reactive Power.
